Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
-- =============================================================================
-- Author:              chengguo.liu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2026-03-10
-- Theme Domain:        MP User Txn Order Complete Feature
-- Data Granularity:    shopee_user_id
-- Description:         
-- Documents:           
-- =============================================================================
--  Version History:
--  2024-10-30 - zongyi.lu ,feature station 迁移, https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11Bpx701mGtwTHd0-TXZE5ickY4HHPFsVCnsui_cWuUM/edit?gid=524192113#gid=524192113
--  2026-03-10 - chengguo.liu - 按主题整合
-- =============================================================================

drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df;
create external table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df (
    shopee_user_id                                string     comment 'shopee user id'
    ,platform_user_id                             string     comment 'platform user id'
    ,completed_order_avg_duration_1m              bigint     comment 'average completed order duration in last 1 month (30 days)'
    ,completed_order_avg_duration_3m              bigint     comment 'average completed order duration in last 3 months (90 days)'
    ,completed_order_avg_duration_6m              bigint     comment 'average completed order duration in last 6 months (180 days)'
    ,last3_completed_order_avg_duration_3m        bigint     comment 'average completed order duration in last 3 months (90 days) for the last 3 completed orders'
    ,uw_confirmed_gmv_usd_90d                     decimal(30, 10)     comment 'confirmed GMV in USD in 90 days'
    ,uw_confirmed_gmv_usd_360d                    decimal(30, 10)     comment 'confirmed GMV in USD in 360 days'
    ,uw_confirmed_order_360d                      bigint     comment 'confirmed order in 360 days'
)
partitioned by (
    grass_date                                        string     comment 'Partition, YYYY-MM-DD'
)
stored as orc tblproperties ("orc.compress"="zstd")
location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_feature/dws/dws_risk_aio_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df/grass_region=${grass_region}';
msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df;


create or replace temporary view complete_order_feature
as
select  buyer_id as platform_user_id
        ,sum(if(date_diff between 0 and 30, complete_duration, 0)) as completed_order_duration_1m
        ,sum(if(date_diff between 0 and 90, complete_duration, 0)) as completed_order_duration_3m
        ,sum(if(date_diff between 0 and 180, complete_duration, 0)) as completed_order_duration_6m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 1, order_id, null)) as completed_order_cnt_1d
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 7, order_id, null)) as completed_order_cnt_7d
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 30, order_id, null)) as completed_order_cnt_1m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 90, order_id, null)) as completed_order_cnt_3m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 180, order_id, null)) as completed_order_cnt_6m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 30 and big_shop_flag = 1, order_id, null)) as big_shop_completed_order_cnt_1m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 90 and big_shop_flag = 1, order_id, null)) as big_shop_completed_order_cnt_3m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 180 and big_shop_flag = 1, order_id, null)) as big_shop_completed_order_cnt_6m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 30 and is_physical_product_order = 'N', order_id, null)) as virtual_completed_order_cnt_1m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 90 and is_physical_product_order = 'N', order_id, null)) as virtual_completed_order_cnt_3m
        ,count(distinct if(date_diff between 0 and 180 and is_physical_product_order = 'N', order_id, null)) as virtual_completed_order_cnt_6m
        ,sum(case when last_3m_rn <= 3 then complete_duration else 0 end) as last3_completed_order_duration_3m
from    (
    select  buyer_id
            ,order_id
            ,complete_date
            ,complete_duration
            ,big_shop_flag
            ,is_physical_product_order
            ,case   when datediff(date('${grass_date}'), complete_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 then row_number() over(partition by buyer_id order by complete_timestamp desc)
                    else 99
             end last_3m_rn
            ,datediff(date('${grass_date}'), complete_date) as date_diff
    from    risk.dwd_risk_order_complete_di a
    where   tz_type = 'local'
      and   grass_region = '${grass_region}'
      and   grass_date >= date_sub('${grass_date}', 180)
      and   grass_date <= date'${grass_date}'
) a
group by buyer_id
;

create or replace temporary view completed_order_avg_duration as
select 
    platform_user_id
    ,case when completed_order_cnt_1m>0 then completed_order_duration_1m/completed_order_cnt_1m else 0 end                                          as completed_order_avg_duration_1m
    ,case when completed_order_cnt_3m>0 then completed_order_duration_3m/completed_order_cnt_3m else 0 end                                          as completed_order_avg_duration_3m
    ,case when completed_order_cnt_6m>0 then completed_order_duration_6m/completed_order_cnt_6m else 0 end                                          as completed_order_avg_duration_6m
    ,case when completed_order_cnt_3m>0 then last3_completed_order_duration_3m/if(completed_order_cnt_3m > 3, 3, completed_order_cnt_3m) else 0 end as last3_completed_order_avg_duration_3m
from complete_order_feature
;

create temporary view uw_confirmed_order_base as
select
    buyer_id as shopee_user_id
    ,order_id
    ,from_unixtime(shipping_confirm_timestamp - 3600) as shipping_confirm_time
    ,gmv_usd
    ,buyer_shipping_address_town
    ,case
        when payment_method_id = 6 then order_id
        else null
    end as cod_orderid
from mp_order.dwd_order_all_ent_df__${region}_s0_live
where
    tz_type = 'local'
    and shipping_confirm_timestamp is not null
    and order_be_status_id in (4, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15)
    and is_bi_excluded = 0
    and has_return_item = 0
    and is_net_order = 1
;

create temporary view uw_confirmed_order_feature as
select
    shopee_user_id
    ,sum(
        case
            when datediff(date'${current_grass_date}', cast(shipping_confirm_time as date)) between 0 and 90 then gmv_usd
            else null
        end
    ) as uw_confirmed_gmv_usd_90d
    ,sum(
        case
            when datediff(date'${current_grass_date}', cast(shipping_confirm_time as date)) between 0 and 360 then gmv_usd
            else null
        end
    ) as uw_confirmed_gmv_usd_360d
    ,count(
        distinct case
            when datediff(date'${current_grass_date}', cast(shipping_confirm_time as date)) between 0 and 360 then order_id
            else null
        end
    ) as uw_confirmed_order_360d
from uw_confirmed_order_base
group by shopee_user_id
;


insert overwrite table ${SCHEMA}.dws_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df partition(grass_date ='${grass_date}')
select
    t1.platform_user_id as shopee_user_id
    ,t1.platform_user_id
    ,t3.completed_order_avg_duration_1m
    ,t3.completed_order_avg_duration_3m
    ,t3.completed_order_avg_duration_6m
    ,t3.last3_completed_order_avg_duration_3m
    ,t4.uw_confirmed_gmv_usd_90d
    ,t4.uw_confirmed_gmv_usd_360d
    ,t4.uw_confirmed_order_360d
from
(
    select
        user_id as platform_user_id
    from mp_user.dim_user__reg_s0_live
    where
        tz_type = 'local'
        and grass_region = '${grass_region}'
        and grass_date = '${grass_date}'
) t1
left join completed_order_avg_duration t3
on t1.platform_user_id = t3.platform_user_id
left join uw_confirmed_order_feature t4
on t1.platform_user_id = t4.shopee_user_id
;
